description: This file defines a class 'CoalescingFSEventsWatcher' that monitors file system events on specified paths using macOS's FSEvents API. It coalesces rapid event changes to avoid redundant notifications and triggers an 'onChange' callback when relevant changes occur.

classes.name: CoalescingFSEventsWatcher
classes.description: A class that watches for file system events on specified paths, coalesces rapid changes, and triggers a callback upon detected changes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the watcher with specified paths, queue label, coalescing delay, notification filter, and change handler.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Stops the watcher and releases resources upon deinitialization.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the file system event stream to begin monitoring.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the monitoring and releases the event stream.

methods.name: handleEvents
methods.description: Handles incoming file system events, applies filtering, coalesces rapid changes, and triggers the 'onChange' callback.
